name: 陣亡者鍊甲衫 Chain Shirt of the Fallen (BMT)

description.value:
護甲（中甲），非普通（需同調）
穿着這套護甲期間，你可以用其施展法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.o9GQEt4fYw6WjpB0]{死者交談 Speak with Dead}或是@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.xYpJGRI4xcMa41kO]{活化死屍 Animate Dead}。以此施展了法術後，直到次日黎明爲止這套護甲都無法再次被用於施展這兩個法術。
這套盔甲會隨着你靈魂的離去而消逝。若你在同調這套護甲期間死亡，這套護甲也將隨之摧毀。

該護甲由互相鎖接的金屬環組成，通常着裝於布衣或皮衣的夾層之間。這種護甲爲着裝者的上半身提供了適中的保護，且鎖環間相互碰撞的聲音也可以被外層衣服減弱。

While wearing this armor, you can use it to cast either @spell[Speak with Dead] or @spell[Animate Dead]. Once the armor has cast a spell in this way, it can't cast either spell until the next dawn.

While wearing this armor, you can use it to cast either @spell[Speak with Dead] or @spell[Animate Dead]. Once the armor has cast a spell in this way, it can't cast either spell until the next dawn.

Your soul keeps this armor together. If you die while you are attuned to the armor, the armor is destroyed.

Made of interlocking metal rings, a chain shirt is worn between layers of clothing or leather. This armor offers modest protection to the wearer's upper body and allows the sound of the rings rubbing against one another to be muffled by outer layers.
